name: Staff of Withering
description: A crooked staff of grey wood that leaves the grass dead where it rests.
attuned_by: by a cleric, druid, or warlock
body:
## What it does

It fights as a magic quarterstaff. When it hits, you can spend a charge to wither the target, which also makes a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or has disadvantage on every Strength and Constitution check and save for an hour.

## Charges

It holds three and regains 1d3 each dawn.

features.name: Withering
features.text: A target withered makes a DC 15 Constitution save or has disadvantage for an hour on Strength and Constitution checks and saves.
